CareerLine.description:
Per-game averages and shooting percentages. A statistic the league did not record yet
(e.g. steals before 1973-74, 3-pointers before 1979-80) is null.
CareerLine.title: CareerLine

CareerStint.description: A team the player appeared for that season; `team` is null for defunct franchises.
CareerStint.title: CareerStint

CoverageBin.description: Interval coverage for predictions in one predicted-minutes bin of the calibration.
CoverageBin.title: CoverageBin

GameForecast.description: Both teams' expected points and the home side's win chance before tip-off.
GameForecast.title: GameForecast

GameForecastResult.description: One requested game with its stored score forecast, or the reason there is none.
GameForecastResult.title: GameForecastResult

GameForecastReview.description: The last score forecast stored before tip-off and, once the game is final, the result.
GameForecastReview.title: GameForecastReview

HistoricSeason.description: One regular season of a franchise as published by the source. None means not recorded.
HistoricSeason.title: HistoricSeason

HistoryEntry.description: A stored prediction for one game next to what happened.
HistoryEntry.title: HistoryEntry

InjuryReport.description: Current listing from the source. `return_date` is its rough estimate, not a promise.
InjuryReport.title: InjuryReport

LiveAccuracy.description: Final pregame forecasts of this release scored against box scores after the games.
LiveAccuracy.title: LiveAccuracy

MatchupDefender.description:
Someone now on the opponent who has guarded this player in past games. Not a prediction of
tonight's matchup: the NBA's tracking data is only published after a game.
MatchupDefender.title: MatchupDefender

MatchupHistory.description: A player's games against one opponent, every season stored (2018-19 onward).
MatchupHistory.title: MatchupHistory

ModelAnalytics.description:
Stored predictions of one release and kind for one statistic, scored against box scores.
Backtests come from the held-out models on the test season; pregame rows are live forecasts.
ModelAnalytics.title: ModelAnalytics

PercentileAxis.description:
One radar axis: each player's season value and league percentile (0–100, higher is
better). A percentile is null when the player has no value for it.
PercentileAxis.title: PercentileAxis

PlayerCareer.description: Every season of a player's career as published by the league, oldest first.
PlayerCareer.title: PlayerCareer

PlayerComparison.description: Two players in the same regular season. `season` is null when they never shared one.
PlayerComparison.title: PlayerComparison

PredictionExplanation.description: What the model received. These are inputs, not attributions of the model's reasoning.
PredictionExplanation.title: PredictionExplanation

ResidualBin.description: Games whose miss (actual minus predicted) fell in [lower, upper).
ResidualBin.title: ResidualBin

UpcomingForecast.description: One scheduled game with its stored forecast, or the reason there is none.
UpcomingForecast.title: UpcomingForecast

VenueSplit.description: A team's results in one setting; a point-margin gap is an association, not a cause.
VenueSplit.title: VenueSplit
